name: napalm-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is NAPALM (`napalm`), the Python library that drives network devices of several vendors
(Arista EOS, Cisco IOS, IOS-XR and NX-OS, Juniper Junos) through one API. It resolves driver names to driver classes
(including custom drivers), parses each driver's `optional_args` and opens the vendor connection, retrieves state
with getters that normalise vendor output, loads, compares and commits configuration, builds compliance reports from
validation files, and ships a mock driver, a command-line tool and helper parsers.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The implementation in scope is the napalm/ package: every Python module under napalm/ except those under
napalm/base/test/. The documentation in scope is: README.md, docs/cli.rst, docs/support/index.rst,
docs/support/eos.rst, docs/support/ios.rst, docs/support/iosxr_netconf.rst, docs/support/nxos.rst,
docs/validate/index.rst, docs/tutorials/mock_driver.rst, docs/tutorials/changing_the_config.rst,
docs/tutorials/context_manager.rst, docs/tutorials/extend_driver.rst, and the module, class and function docstrings
of the in-scope Python modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
